div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No SA holds two of {identity, buyer terms, evidence, revocation}; the consent arbiter holds none.
A monolith here would itself be the violation.
Numbers trace to /docs/metrics.json.
Identity, commercial, evidence and adjudication data were migrated to named databases
and are served by private workloads under IAM-conditioned service accounts; the front door
is refused by Google IAM on all four. The shared append-only grant log stays in (default),
so counterparty row separation inside it remains gateway-enforced by design.
Revocation-worker IAM hardening and route cutover are implemented but unverified live.
Signing: Cloud KMS on the last verified deployment / labelled-ephemeral Ed25519 offline;
hodi verify checks with the public key only.
